import random

def expected_max(m, n):
    num_simulations = 100000
    total_max = 0
    
    for _ in range(num_simulations):
        max_value = 0
        for _ in range(n):
            roll = random.randint(1, m)
            max_value = max(max_value, roll)
        total_max += max_value
    
    return total_max / num_simulations
